title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-09-05-r37.

This front-facing cumulative reader preserves every Korean EGA unit admitted by source, translation, typesetting and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme/table of contents; and a contiguous translation of the EGA II main text through Proposition §2.1.9, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1605. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete. No claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, perfection or external human certification is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean EGA lineage. The exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22315714 identifies this immutable r37 checkpoint. Working repository: github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko.

The r37 increment translates §2.1.8 and Proposition §2.1.9 with its proof, canonical lines 1537–1605. It preserves the graded-ring and graded-module indices, Veronese constructions, degree bounds, finite-generation equivalence, quantified variables, references and proof structure. At source line 1542, malformed French punctuation and an orphaned phrase are rendered according to the syntactically coherent intended condition and recorded transparently. At source line 1572, the unquantified m in S_{n-mk} is preserved diplomatically and routed as a nonblocking source-canon query; this edition does not silently adjudicate the source.

The new 3,727-character source slice is 3,776 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 D91203350D0012E008CA3A778DD5ABB1E3A18D70641C753F6F86ECFF51F949FE. The admitted canonical prefix is 73,897 bytes, SHA-256 0815285B46DA35D916612CDDACB92A1DD646153FAF6AC0D15E03417F9D349182. The Korean target is 75,622 bytes, SHA-256 FA2AA45404EE63442184A43AD744DE0D03CC053C77C35DA26A0ED8044CB1A383; the admitted candidate is 4,073 bytes, SHA-256 A423B075B3483FC84CA580AED46C651F84543F4444805D94388CD5574114063D.

The cumulative PDF has 238 pages, 1,479,200 bytes, SHA-256 22EB1097A3BD0B9DDAEF5C64D10D06561DFADDBA5FD08B80CE417C85FBF79F61, and retains 227 historical printed-page markers. Two clean four-pass XeLaTeX cycles require pass 3 and pass 4 to be byte-identical within each cycle and require the final PDFs to be byte-identical across cycles. Evidence binds editable TeX, coverage, source authority, terminology and translation controls, expert-review views, build logs, independent extraction paths, links, selected renders and SHA-256 inventories. Legacy Type1 mathematics fonts lack complete ToUnicode mappings: extracted mathematical text is not lossless; TeX and rendered formulas remain authoritative. Hard reproducible checks establish tested properties, not perfection. Defects and uncertainties are corrected in later immutable versions.

Historical creators: Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independent translation is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories or cited third parties.

CC BY 4.0 applies only where this project holds the relevant rights: the Korean translation and typesetting, project-authored metadata, indexes, decisions and QA evidence. It makes no blanket public-domain or open-license claim for the underlying mathematical work, historical French edition, NUMDAM files, bibliography or third-party content. Each source retains its exact provenance, attribution, author/source relationship, rights and licence status.
